new_findings_this_task.resolution: Read both scripts in full. This is PURE CALENDAR-SESSION-DATE ARITHMETIC (a list of ISO date strings from a trading-calendar library), used ONLY to build a sufficiently long backward-indexable session list from which the actual evaluation window is sliced as `sessions[-60:]` (FPRC) / `evaluation[-60:]` (ORPB) -- i.e. the last 60 trading sessions before each protocol's real exposure boundary (2025-08-15 for FPRC per EXPOSURE_BOUNDARY constant; 2025-05-05 for ORPB per the range's own end date). NO price data, NO bar, NO strategy outcome, NO P&L is ever computed for 2024 by either script -- 2024-01-01 is merely a start-of-lookback anchor for calendar indexing. This is a STRICTLY WEAKER category than EXPOSED_DATA_ONLY -- no data (price or otherwise) about 2024 was ever touched, only the count/sequence of NYSE trading days.
new_findings_this_task.classification_impact: Does not disqualify 2024 from CLEAN_UNSEEN for price-data/outcome purposes.

new_findings_this_task.resolution: Traced to the ledger's own 'Build the talonx_backtest engine itself' founding-commit entry (2026-08-16) -- this is INFRASTRUCTURE documentation for a general-purpose backtester (talonx_backtest, which replays the CURRENT PRODUCTION talonx_quant momentum/RSI/MACD/confluence strategy -- confirmed via ledger line 3352, 'talonx_backtest imports and calls the exact same compute_indicators function' -- a STRUCTURALLY DIFFERENT strategy family from F6_FADE_V1's opening-move fade logic). No results/taskNN_.../ directory, ledger entry, or committed report anywhere in this repo shows this tool having actually been EXECUTED against real, fully-downloaded 2024 Alpaca data with genuine trade-level P&L/win-rate/expectancy figures reported -- the only reproduced figures shown anywhere (docs/backtesting.md's example) are a DATA QUALITY report (row count, gap count, duplicate/NaN/Inf/OHLC-validity counts) -- explicitly NOT a strategy outcome. exposure_boundary_audit.json's systematic 6101-line ledger grep also found nothing here. data/historical_1m/ in this worktree presently contains ONLY task67a_development and task67a_benchmarks -- no 2024 data is on disk.
new_findings_this_task.classification_impact: Classified EXPOSED_DATA_ONLY (conservative -- cannot rule out with certainty that the documentation example's row-count figures derive from some real, unrecorded run) rather than CLEAN_UNSEEN, out of caution. All three EXPOSED_DATA_ONLY conditions are satisfied: (1) no F6-equivalent OR any strategy outcome was ever shown for 2024 -- only a data-quality/row-count report, if even that was real; (2) F6's design (independently developed entirely within the 2026-05-15..2026-08-14 window, per f6_lineage_confirmed above) could not have been informed by a generic backtest tool's row-count documentation example, nor by a structurally unrelated momentum strategy's hypothetical outcome; (3) this task locks the period below before computing any F6 outcome against it.
